cases.explain: Отец is the subject of любит ('loves'), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Вас отлучат от ___, и даже наступит такое время, когда убивающие вас будут думать, что они тем самым служат Богу.
cases.explain: The preposition от ('from') governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я пришел в мир от Отца, и сейчас Я покидаю этот мир и ухожу к ___.
cases.explain: The preposition к ('to, toward') governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я пришел в ___ от Отца, и сейчас Я покидаю этот мир и ухожу к Отцу.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('into') with a verb of motion governs the accusative; for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative.

cases.sentence: Я говорил вам ___, но наступает время, когда я не буду говорить притчами, а скажу вам прямо об Отце.
cases.explain: The instrumental case here expresses manner or means ('speaking by means of parables') without a preposition.

cases.sentence: Он обличит мир в его неправильном суждении о грехе, о праведности и о ___.
cases.explain: The preposition о ('about') governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Вас отлучат от синагог, и даже наступит такое время, когда убивающие вас будут думать, что они тем самым служат Богу.
reading.question: What warning does Jesus give about persecution to come?
options: They will be expelled from synagogues, and some who kill them will think they are serving God
They will be given great wealth
They will be praised by all people
reading.correct: They will be expelled from synagogues, and some who kill them will think they are serving God
reading.explain: Jesus warns they will be put out of synagogues, and their killers will think they are serving God.

reading.ru: Сердца ваши полны печали, потому что я рассказал вам это».
reading.question: How do the disciples feel after hearing Jesus's words?
options: Their hearts are filled with grief
reading.correct: Their hearts are filled with grief
reading.explain: Jesus says their hearts are filled with sorrow because he has told them these things.

reading.ru: Если я не уйду, то заступник не придет к вам, но если я пойду, то пошлю его к вам.
reading.question: What does Jesus say will happen if he goes away?
options: He will send the Counselor to them
The disciples will never see him again
reading.correct: He will send the Counselor to them
reading.explain: Jesus says that if he goes away, he will send the Counselor to them.

reading.ru: Когда он придет, то обличит мир в его неправильном суждении о грехе, о праведности и о суде
reading.question: What three things will the Counselor convict the world about?
reading.explain: The Counselor will convict the world regarding sin, righteousness, and judgment.

reading.ru: Вот когда Дух истины придет, Он введет вас во всю полноту истины.
reading.question: What will the Spirit of truth do when he comes?
options: Guide the disciples into all truth
Take Jesus's place as teacher forever
reading.correct: Guide the disciples into all truth
reading.explain: Jesus says the Spirit of truth will guide them into all truth.

reading.ru: Пройдет немного времени, и вы меня уже не увидите, но пройдет еще немного времени, и вы опять увидите меня.
reading.question: What does Jesus tell the disciples will happen 'in a little while'?
options: They will not see him, then a little while later they will see him again
They will become rulers of the world
reading.correct: They will not see him, then a little while later they will see him again
reading.explain: Jesus says a little while and they will not see him, then again a little while and they will see him.

reading.ru: Когда женщине подходит время родить, у нее начинаются боли, но как только ребенок родится, она забывает боль от радости, что в мир родился человек.
reading.question: What analogy does Jesus use to describe the disciples' coming grief turning to joy?
options: A woman in labor whose pain turns to joy at childbirth
reading.correct: A woman in labor whose pain turns to joy at childbirth
reading.explain: Jesus compares their grief to a woman in labor whose pain turns to joy once the child is born.

reading.ru: Говорю вам истину, Отец даст вам все, что вы не попросите у Него во имя Мое, пока вы во имя Мое не просили ничего.
reading.question: What does Jesus promise about prayers made in his name?
options: The Father will give whatever they ask for in Jesus's name
Only priests may pray in his name
The Father will ignore all requests
reading.correct: The Father will give whatever they ask for in Jesus's name
reading.explain: Jesus promises the Father will give them whatever they ask for in his name.

reading.ru: Я сказал вам все это, чтобы вы нашли во мне мир. В этом же мире вас ожидают невзгоды, но будьте мужественны. Я победил этот мир.
reading.question: How does Jesus conclude his teaching about the world?
options: He tells them to take heart because he has overcome the world
He tells them to flee the world
He tells them the world will conquer them
He tells them to avoid all trouble
reading.correct: He tells them to take heart because he has overcome the world
reading.explain: Jesus concludes by telling them to take heart, for he has overcome the world.
